body: The promotion centre places the pagoda in thôn Chi Phong, xã Trường Yên, huyện Hoa Lư, between the river and the cliff of the Tràng An country. It dates the foundation to the Dinh and Early Le, around the 10th century. The story it prints is that Princess Lê Thị Phất Ngân, daughter of Lê Đại Hành, made a marriage promise here with Lý Công Uẩn, and that their son Lý Phật Mã, later Lý Thái Tông, was born in 1000. It says the pagoda took the name Duyên Ninh after Lý Thái Tông put down the revolt of Khai Quốc Vương, and that the queen spent her last years here watching her father's tomb.

The same page says people come to ask for a match, and also for family ties that are wider than a couple. The gate you walk through carries the name Chùa Duyên Ninh. The halls sit on a tiled court with the cliff behind them. A minute on site, a gate fee, and an opening hour were not printed.
